Carla_Acme: Hi team — Acme audit asked for our ISO27001 mapping specifically around data retention, audit logs, and KMS/HSM custody. They also reported intermittent 504s last week and want repro steps and logs to correlate with their audit. Can we escalate? Case SUP-4921.

Alice_Support: Thanks @Carla_Acme. Escalating to infosec + eng. I'll collate artifacts and ask for repro info. Added case SUP-4921 to the queue. :rotating_light:

DevOpsBot: Incident created: INC-2026-02-Acme504. Initial alert: 2026-02-03T03:05:12Z. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026-02-Acme504

Ben_InfoSec: Hi all — for ISO mapping customers usually need: (a) retention schedules by data class, (b) example audit log exports with schema, (c) KMS key lifecycle and access controls, (d) HSM attestation or papertrail of key generation/rotation. Do they want raw logs or a mapping document? :thinking:

Carla_Acme: They prefer a mapping doc plus a sample export. They explicitly asked for auditlog entries showing access/grant events + key rotation events within the last 12 months.

Frank_Eng: For the 504s we'll need a sample request_id from the customer and the approximate timestamp. If you can get a request_id we can pull backend traces. Repro checklist we use:
1) curl with headers to capture full response
2) include X-Request-ID in the call
3) capture seq length and model param

Example debug curl:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -H "X-Request-ID: acme-req-123" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-4r","input":"hello","max_tokens":64}' \
  https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Also send gateway/nginx logs around the timestamp and the matching X-Trace id if present. We'll check autoscaler logs and GPU-scheduler metrics.

Edu_Product: FYI finance reported a cost spike for Acme org on 2026-02-03 03:00 UTC that might align with the incident. @Frank_Eng can you check whether model fallback/burst scaling happened then?

Frank_Eng: Will check. Initial guess: short-lived autoscale and degraded batching -> increased latency and 504s. Will confirm with scheduler logs.

Alice_Support: I'll ask Acme CS to provide 3 example request_ids (one that hit 504, one slow, one normal) + timeframe. I'll also upload these initial artifacts to the shared secure folder: retention_policy_v2.pdf, auditlog_sample_20260203.json, kms_rotation_log_2025.csv, hsm_attestation_20251201.pdf

Ben_InfoSec: Once artifacts are in the folder I'll produce an ISO mapping table (control -> evidence -> owner) and a short narrative for auditors. If they want exported logs, we'll redact PII and provide hashes for integrity. :white_check_mark:

Carla_Acme: Thanks all. ETA from the customer: auditor deadline EOW. Can we aim to have mapping doc + samples by Friday? 

Alice_Support: Agreed. Owners: Ben (mapping + redaction), Frank (repro + scheduler check), Alice (artifact upload + contact). I'll post progress updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
